title: Fragen und Inversion
summary: How to ask yes/no questions by inversion, and the six W-words that start every real question

blocks.title: Ja/Nein-Fragen: Inversion
blocks.body: To ask a yes/no question, just **swap the verb and subject**: *Du kommst.* → *Kommst du?* (You're coming. → Are you coming?) *Du hast Zeit.* → *Hast du Zeit?* No extra word needed — German doesn't do an English-style "do you…".

blocks.title: W-Fragen: wer, was, wo, wann, wie, warum
blocks.body: Question words start the sentence, and the verb still comes right after — **slot two, no exceptions**: *Wo wohnst du?* (Where do you live?), *Wann kommst du?* (When are you coming?), *Warum lernst du Deutsch?* (Why are you learning German?). The six essentials: **wer** (who), **was** (what), **wo** (where), **wann** (when), **wie** (how), **warum** (why).
blocks.callout: Same V2 law as everywhere else — the question word just takes slot one.

pairs.note: Swap in a question word up front; the verb still sits in slot two.
Yes/no inversion vs. a W-question — same verb position either way.

blocks.prompt: Which is the correct question for 'Where do you live?'
blocks.explain: *Wo* takes slot one, the verb *wohnst* takes slot two, and *du* follows — Wo wohnst du?

blocks.prompt: Turn into a question: 'Du hast Zeit.'
blocks.hint: Swap the verb and the subject.
blocks.explain: Hast du Zeit? — the verb *hast* jumps to the front, no extra word needed.

blocks.scene: Aylin is getting to know you better over coffee and asks about your life in Berlin.

lines.speaker: Aylin
lines.nl: Wie lange wohnst du schon in Berlin?
lines.en: How long have you been living in Berlin already?

lines.speaker: Aylin
lines.en: And where exactly do you live?

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: In Neukölln. Die Wohnung ist klein, aber schön.
lines.en: In Neukölln. The apartment is small, but nice.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Ich lerne Deutsch und ich arbeite hier.
lines.en: I'm learning German and I work here.

lines.speaker: Aylin
lines.en: How do you find the city?
lines.spotlight: *Wie findest du…?* — a natural way to ask someone's opinion.

questions.q: How long has the learner lived in Berlin?

blocks.prompt: Write 3 questions you'd ask a new friend in Berlin — use at least one W-word and one yes/no inversion question.
